name: learnui
description: A learning monorepo for accessible Web and React Native components.

scripts.test: pnpm test:foundation && pnpm pack:web:check && pnpm smoke:web && pnpm --filter @learnui/native test && pnpm --filter native-gallery test && node scripts/verify-native-public-imports.mjs
scripts.pack:web:check: pnpm --filter @learnui/web build && node scripts/check-web-pack.mjs && pnpm --filter @learnui/web exec publint
